pr_title: remove LegacyNodeRoleBehavior and mv ServiceNodeExclusion to GA
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/sig network
/area kubelet

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
According to KEP from https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/54b409decd8d2e7f8a631fb845db58c810b4254c/keps/sig-architecture/2019-07-16-node-role-label-use.md
Master link:
https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-architecture/1143-node-role-labels

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #97542 

Part of #94495
@thockin @smarterclayton @rikatz

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

During investigating the 97542 in my kubelet log, I read the KEP and #94495 comments. It needs to be done in 1.21.

The part related to #97542  is the function of node checking. 
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/97543/files#diff-62d886bf35c4945f56ff8cfd3d60e9f47a0deb8f6b3d09d89f48aacf3ba7b70eL972-L977


**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
[ACTION REQUIRED] `ServiceNodeExclusion`, `NodeDisruptionExclusion` and `LegacyNodeRoleBehavior`(locked to false) features have been promoted to GA. 
To prevent control plane nodes from being added to load balancers automatically, upgrade users need to add "node.kubernetes.io/exclude-from-external-load-balancers" label to control plane nodes.
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

```docs
- [KEP]: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-architecture/1143-node-role-labels
```

@pacoxu thanks for raising this.

Overall it looks good to me, but as a previous discussion we've had with sig-apimachinery and sig-arch:

1) Not GA'd feature gates should first be moved to GA and locked to the default (true for ServiceNodeExclusion and NodeDisruptionExclusion, false for LegacyNodeRoleBehavior per KEP) and then removed from kube_features.go in v1.22

2) I will do another pass into the code to check also if some FG or some reference is removed, although it seems the tests just passed fine :)

Can you please correct the FG versioning? Thanks!!
/retest

@pacoxu left two more reviews: one to insert the proper comment of which is the version we're marking LegacyNodeRoleBehavior to GA and other to change LegacyNodeRoleBehavior to featuregate.GA (you left this as Beta).

Thanks!

More comments: in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/v1.20.1/staging/src/k8s.io/cloud-provider/controllers/service/controller.go#L69 I guess we can remove the reference to ServiceNodeExclusion gate, as we're removing it.

/hold

One more thing: I don't think that deprecating and locking a feature gate is not worth of a Release Note, so can you please change the description in the PR?

Thank you!!!
Thanks a lot @rikatz  fixed per your comments and add a release note.

issue_context.title: kubelet log continuously prints  "Initializing eviction metric for zone"
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:
The node name is `daocloud-master`.

```
I1228 07:38:27.124528       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1429] Initializing eviction metric for zone: paco::zone2
I1228 07:38:32.124936       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1429] Initializing eviction metric for zone: paco::zone2
I1228 07:38:37.126648       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1429] Initializing eviction metric for zone: paco::zone2
I1228 07:38:42.127029       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1429] Initializing eviction metric for zone: paco::zone2
I1228 07:38:47.127361       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1429] Initializing eviction metric for zone: paco::zone2
I1228 07:38:52.127598       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1429] Initializing eviction metric for zone: paco::zone2
```

**What you expected to happen**:


A normal node log is like below
```
I1228 06:14:14.099144       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1429] Initializing eviction metric for zone: region::zone
I1228 06:14:14.099284       1 node_lifecycle_controller.go:1245] Controller detected that zone region::zone is now in state Normal.
```

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:
run kube in a node whose hostname ends with "master"

/sig node
/sig network

/area kubelet

review_comments: Per KEP, should be defaulted to false and locked.
don't forget here to put the version we're doing this into GA :)
Per feature lifecycle, shouldn't this be locked to default before removing it?

Also, per the KEP this should be defaulted to FALSE: 

Release 4 (1.20):

"Default the legacy gate LegacyNodeRoleBehavior to off. Admins whose deployments still use the old labels may set LegacyNodeRoleBehavior=true during 1.19 to get the legacy behavior."

I imagine this change is going to break some users since control plane nodes will now be added to load balancers automatically when previously they were not. Can we add an `ACTION REQUIRED` to the release notes and call out that users need to add the `labelNodeExcludeBalancer` label to control plane nodes if they want to preserve this behaviour?

Need I edit the release note like this. @neolit123  @andrewsykim 
```
`ServiceNodeExclusion`, `NodeDisruptionExclusion` and `LegacyNodeRoleBehavior`(locked to false) features have been promoted to GA. 
To prevent control plane nodes being added to load balancers automatically, upgrade users need to add "node.kubernetes.io/exclude-from-external-load-balancers"  label to control plane nodes.
```
Yes, that would be better than the current release notes
This should not be removed yet, as it's not GA'd and locked
followup nit - we should rename this to "labelNodeExcludeBalancers" or something  -  "role" has no place any more :)
